label.administrable_evidence: Eligible applicants under the ADCMS Competitive Grant Program are State Departments of Transportation (State DOT), including the District of Columbia and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico.
label.match_evidence: The ADCMS Competitive Grant Program requires a minimum cost share of 20 percent of total project costs.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The ADCMS grant program focuses on transportation technology and does not directly align with any of the health and human services goals or objectives in the NC DHHS Strategic Plan.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The ADCMS grant program focuses on transportation technology and does not directly align with any of the veteran services goals or objectives in the NC DMVA Strategic Plan.
